title: OUR SOUND 05
imageAlt: The UNIT/20 dancefloor from behind the booth
description: We're super stoked to be taking over Unit 20 with an insanely stacked lineup for you all. For this momentous occasion, we thought to bring down Poneke-based, multi-genre selecta, Licious. The night will be filled with increasing tempos and a plethora of club music and will have you dancing till your last dart. We have curated the rest of the lineup with some of the best producers/DJs the 03 has to offer.
